list.name: React API Layer
list.description: Public package entry plus the React bindings (WebSocketProvider context and the useSubscription/useSend/useConnectionState/useDynamicConnection hooks) that expose named WebSocket connections to components.

list.name: Core Client Layer
list.description: Framework-agnostic WebSocketClient handling connection lifecycle, heartbeats, typed pub/sub dispatch and offline queuing, together with the exponential and fixed backoff reconnect strategies it uses.

list.name: Types Layer
list.description: Shared type definitions (ConnectionState, BaseMessage, handler callbacks, BackoffStrategy, WebSocketClientOptions) imported by every other source module.

list.name: Build & Tooling Configuration
list.description: npm manifest, publish settings, TypeScript project configs, ESLint rules, and the Vite library-mode build plus Vitest setup that produce the dual ESM/CJS distribution.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: README usage guide and API reference for the provider, hooks and client, plus the MIT license.

file:src/client/WebsocketClient.ts.name: WebsocketClient.ts
file:src/client/WebsocketClient.ts.summary: Framework-agnostic, generic WebSocket client handling connection lifecycle, backoff-based reconnects, heartbeats with dead-connection detection, type-keyed pub/sub dispatch, and an offline outbound message queue.

file:src/context/WebSocketProvider.tsx.name: WebSocketProvider.tsx
file:src/context/WebSocketProvider.tsx.summary: React context provider that lazily creates and caches named WebSocketClient instances from static connection configs or a resolve function, handling Strict Mode remounts and cleanup.

file:src/hooks/index.ts.name: index.ts
file:src/hooks/index.ts.summary: Public React hooks API for accessing named WebSocket connections: retrieving clients, subscribing to message types, tracking connection state, sending, closing, and following dynamic ID-based connections.

file:src/types/index.ts.name: index.ts
file:src/types/index.ts.summary: Shared type definitions: ConnectionState enum, generic BaseMessage, handler and unsubscribe callback types, BackoffStrategy, and WebSocketClientOptions.

file:src/utils/Backoff.ts.name: Backoff.ts
file:src/utils/Backoff.ts.summary: Reconnect delay strategies: exponential backoff with full jitter and a fixed-delay strategy, both returning BackoffStrategy functions.
